description: Block 6: assemble the full deterministic state machine ERL-raid -> SMT -> bearish MSS -> IDM forms -> IDM cleared -> return to QM/POI -> lower-TF (M5) confirmation -> entry with SL/TP, using the H4->H1->M15->M5 cascade. EVERY unconfirmed rule is a variant switch or parameter; NOTHING is pre-selected as best. Bearish primary with the bullish mirror. Depends on Blocks 1-5 (FEAT-001..003).
steps: Create v1_lab/qm_state_machine.py, pure stdlib, importing the detectors: qm_detect (swings/MSS), ny_session (session/legs), erl_detect (ERL raid), idm_detect (IDM + cleared), poi_zone (POI/QM + OB/FVG), smt_detect (SMT + corr guard).

Implement deterministic H4/H1/M15 resampling from the M15 (and M5) CSVs (calendar-aligned OHLC aggregation; document the aggregation boundaries). H4 POI -> H1 -> M15 structure -> M5 execution cascade: POI/bias from higher TF, structure on M15, entry confirmation on M5. Resampling must be causal (a higher-TF bar is only 'closed' and usable after its final constituent lower-TF bar).

Implement the state machine as an explicit causal sequence with states: WAIT_ERL_RAID -> (SMT check) -> WAIT_MSS -> WAIT_IDM_FORM -> WAIT_IDM_CLEAR -> WAIT_POI_RETURN -> WAIT_M5_CONFIRM -> ENTRY. Each transition uses only information available at the decision bar (no lookahead). Emit a trade record at ENTRY with entry price/time, direction, SL, TP, and the variant configuration that produced it.

Expose EVERY open rule as a variant switch / parameter with a sensible default, NONE pre-optimized: smt_pair (xag|dxy|off), poi_type (qm|qm_ob|qm_fvg), sl_mode (head_smt_high_buffer | tight_poi) with sl_buffer_atr (ATR-multiple param), tp_mode (full_external | fixed_rr | partial_be_trail) with min_projected_rr gate (param), idm_clear_required (True=A+ | False=experimental), pivot (swing L/R), erl_tf (ERL source TF), session_scope (ny_only | ny_london_asia), max_trades_per_day and reentry (risk params). Represent a variant configuration as an explicit dict/namedtuple so a runner can enumerate combinations.

SL/TP and trade outcome: given entry, SL, TP, simulate the trade forward on the execution TF (M5) causally to determine exit (SL-hit-before-TP vs TP vs timeout), producing a realized net result. Keep costs as a pre-declared parameter (spread/commission) passed through, not invented. This produces a trade with a net profit usable by the pipeline.

qm_state_machine.py --selfcheck: construct a synthetic multi-bar scenario that walks the FULL happy path (ERL raid -> MSS -> IDM formed+cleared -> POI return -> M5 confirm -> entry) and assert exactly one trade is produced with the expected direction and that SL/TP are placed per the selected sl_mode/tp_mode; then a negative scenario missing one required step (e.g. IDM never cleared with idm_clear_required=True) produces NO trade; then flip idm_clear_required=False on the same negative scenario and assert a trade now appears (proving the variant switch is the discriminator and nothing is hard-coded).

Real-data run: `python3 v1_lab/qm_state_machine.py v1_lab/XAUUSD_M15_clean.csv --m5 v1_lab/XAUUSD_M5_clean.csv` with the DEFAULT variant prints the number of setups reaching each state and the number of completed trades, deterministically, and writes a trade list via --out (in a schema the Block 7 runner can convert to the pipeline's 'time,profit' format). Report counts for the default config.
acceptance_criteria: `python3 v1_lab/qm_state_machine.py --selfcheck` prints 'selfcheck: PASS': the full happy path yields exactly one correctly-directed trade with SL/TP per the chosen modes; a missing-step scenario yields no trade; flipping the relevant variant switch changes the outcome (proving variants are real and no rule is hard-coded).

Every open rule (smt_pair, poi_type, sl_mode+sl_buffer_atr, tp_mode+min_projected_rr, idm_clear_required, pivot, erl_tf, session_scope, max_trades_per_day, reentry) is a variant switch/parameter with a documented default; none is pre-selected as best.
H4/H1/M15/M5 resampling and the whole state machine are causal (no lookahead), demonstrated in the self-check construction.
Real-data run on the M15 (+M5) files is deterministic (byte-identical --out on re-run) and reports per-state counts and completed-trade count for the default variant.
verification: python3 v1_lab/qm_state_machine.py v1_lab/XAUUSD_M15_clean.csv --m5 v1_lab/XAUUSD_M5_clean.csv --out v1_lab/qm_trades_default.csv  (record per-state + trade counts; run twice, md5 identical)
findings:
Implemented v1_lab/qm_state_machine.py (pure stdlib, reuses all Blocks 1-5 via the sys.path.insert import pattern). Exposes a VariantConfig namedtuple with every open rule as a documented, NON-pre-optimized default (smt_pair=off, poi_type=qm, sl_mode=head_smt_high_buffer+sl_buffer_atr=0.5, tp_mode=full_external+fixed_rr=2.0, min_projected_rr=1.0, idm_clear_required=True, idm_clear_mode=wick, pivot=2, disp=0.6, erl_lookback=5, erl_tf=H1, session_scope=ny_only, max_trades_per_day=2, reentry=False, corr_window=20, corr_min=0.3, data_tz=America/New_York, spread=0, commission=0, risk_per_trade=100, max_hold_bars_m5=288). Programmatic run(bars_or_paths, config)->(trades, stats) plus a CLI. Higher-TF ERL resampling is causal (bars restamped at bucket CLOSE via resample_causal so a HTF level is only visible after its final constituent closes). State machine WAIT_ERL_RAID->SMT_CHECK->WAIT_MSS->WAIT_IDM_FORM->WAIT_IDM_CLEAR->WAIT_POI_RETURN->WAIT_M5_CONFIRM->ENTRY, bearish primary + bullish mirror. IDM clearing is evaluated over the POI-return horizon (explicit window, per FEAT-002 note). At ENTRY a trade record is emitted and simulated causally on M5 (SL-before-TP resolved conservatively as SL-first within a bar) yielding a net result usable by the pipeline; to_pipeline_rows() emits the 'time,profit' (YYYY.MM.DD HH:MM) format for the Block-7 runner.

SELF-CHECK: `python3 v1_lab/qm_state_machine.py --selfcheck` prints 'selfcheck: PASS'. case A: full happy path => exactly one bearish trade, SL above / TP below entry, one setup passes IDM_CLEAR..ENTRY, funnel monotonic non-increasing, trade simulated on M5. case B: IDM never cleared + idm_clear_required=True => 0 trades. case C: flip idm_clear_required=False on the SAME scenario => a trade appears (the switch is the discriminator, nothing hard-coded). case D: truncating M15 at the POI-return bar leaves the entry decision unchanged (causal / no lookahead). case E: re-run yields byte-identical trades (deterministic). Bullish mirror separately verified (SL below / TP above entry).

REAL-DATA RUN (default variant, M15 22849 bars + M5 68418 bars): per-state funnel = WAIT_ERL_RAID 3243, SMT_CHECK 3243, WAIT_MSS 3243, WAIT_IDM_FORM 3243, WAIT_IDM_CLEAR 967, WAIT_POI_RETURN 967, WAIT_M5_CONFIRM 967, ENTRY 155. Completed trades = 155 (bear 92, bull 63; exits: tp 25, sl 97, timeout 33; sum net = +3601.17 at risk_per_trade=100, zero costs). Determinism confirmed: --out (v1_lab/qm_trades_default.csv) byte-identical across two runs (md5 83142bd6f15c7d49ab6c9eb0bae33ca9). Byte-compile: py_compile of all v1_lab/*.py OK; all sibling module self-checks still PASS. SMT data-dependency handled honestly: smt_pair xag/dxy without --pair-csv reports 'UNAVAILABLE' (XAGUSD/DXY not in repo) and the SMT_CHECK becomes a pass-through so the engine still runs, rather than fabricating partner data. NOTE: some entry rows share an entry_index/datetime when two MSS shifts map to the same POI+return; this is deterministic and left for the Block-7 runner to de-dupe/aggregate if desired.
